verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Qdrant serves an llms.txt at qdrant.tech/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured summary of the product, so an agent can be pointed at it directly. Qdrant also publishes agent skills on GitHub for AI coding assistants, which are additional agent-oriented guidance. missing for 10: markdown renditions of the docs pages (the docs .md probe returned 404), evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt content is beyond its summary header.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Qdrant provides a collection of ready-to-use agent skills that bring Qdrant's vector search capabilities directly into your AI coding assistant.
